theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfr_plane_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ι : Fin n → Fin P) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), StrictMono ι → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ i, (∀ j, ι j ≠ i) → a i = x i) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ))) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ α = -α (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) (1 : ℝ)))
